shots.prompt: Locked camera, continuous detailed drawn anime. Preserve both faces, summer clothes, jewelry, earbud wires and courtyard. They begin with small smiles. He playfully mouths a brief phrase and glances at her. She turns her attention toward him and answers with a short spontaneous laugh. He responds with a warm smile, then both settle into shared smiles. Their eyes and mouths stay proportionate to their original faces. Shoulders breathe naturally; bodies stay seated, hands in their pictured places. Keep the response passing between them, with quiet warmth.
